features: [STQC & GOVERNMENT APPROVED]: Fully compliant with 2026 Indian cybersecurity mandates. Tested for advanced data encryption and secure firmware, making it the trusted choice for both home and government projects.
[4G SIM CONNECTIVITY]: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Simply insert a 4G SIM card (Jio, Airtel, Vi supported) for instant, high-speed remote monitoring from anywhere in the world via your smartphone.
[360° TOTAL COVERAGE]: Eliminate blind spots with motorized 355° Pan and 90° Tilt. Control the camera's movement remotely to get a full view of your surroundings in 3MP Crystal Clear HD.
[SMART AI HUMAN DETECTION]: Advanced Edge AI distinguishes between humans and animals/trees. The camera automatically tracks moving persons and sends real-time alerts to your phone.
[FULL COLOR NIGHT VISION]: Equipped with dual-light technology. Choose between Infrared or Full-Color Night Vision to capture clear facial details and license plates even in total darkness.
[TWO-WAY AUDIO & ALEXA]: Built-in high-sensitivity mic and speaker allow you to talk to visitors or warn off intruders. Fully compatible with Alexa for hands-free voice control.
[WEATHERPROOF & DURABLE]: Rated IP66 Waterproof, this camera is built to withstand heavy monsoons, dust, and extreme heat, ensuring reliable outdoor performance year-round.
[MAX STORAGE CAPACITY]: Supports up to a 256GB Memory Card for weeks of continuous local recording. Secure cloud storage options are also available for added data backup.
